issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode changed from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a silent contract change for existing callers.
issues.detail: Existing users instantiating InputParams() will silently switch endpointing modes, changing observable behavior (VAD emission, finalization triggers). The supertype contract callers relied on has been weakened without a deprecation path. State the migration explicitly in the changelog and consider a transitional warning when the default is taken.

issues.description: LSP-VIOLATION: process_frame now ignores UserStoppedSpeakingFrame, narrowing the accepted supertype.
issues.detail: The base STTService contract presumably promises finalization on UserStoppedSpeakingFrame; this subtype now only finalizes on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame. Callers wiring non-VAD producers of UserStoppedSpeakingFrame will silently lose finalization. Either document the stricter precondition at the supertype level or accept both frame types.

issues.description: SPEC-MISSING: _enable_vad semantics now couple TurnDetectionMode and EndOfUtteranceMode without stated invariant.
issues.detail: _enable_vad is derived from EndOfUtteranceMode, but the new default TurnDetectionMode.FIXED implicitly maps to EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED elsewhere. The invariant 'FIXED/EXTERNAL disables internal VAD; others enable it' should be written down at the class boundary, or the two enums should be unified. Right now the contract lives only in the list literal.

issues.description: split_sentences default applied unconditionally overrides any vendor default for speech_segment_config.
issues.detail: config.speech_segment_config is always replaced with SpeechSegmentConfig(emit_sentences=False) when split_sentences is None. If the upstream VoiceAgentConfig has a meaningful default, this silently clobbers it. Prefer setting only when params.split_sentences is not None, preserving the vendor contract for omitted parameters.

issues.description: Docstring for turn_detection_mode still says EXTERNAL is default in one place while code defaults to FIXED.
issues.detail: The class-level enum docstring was updated to FIXED, and InputParams docstring was updated, but the operating contract for what FIXED means (vs EXTERNAL) is not described. A reader cannot tell from the spec what guarantees FIXED provides. Add a one-paragraph contract for each mode.

review.summary: The change is mostly mechanical wiring for a new SDK version, but it quietly mutates two contracts: the default endpointing mode and the frame class that triggers finalization. Both are LSP-adjacent issues — a caller of the prior InputParams or the prior process_frame contract will observe different behavior after upgrade without a code change. The _enable_vad invariant now spans two enums and deserves an explicit specification at the module boundary. The split_sentences wiring unconditionally overwrites a vendor default, which is a small leak of internal assumptions through the configuration boundary. Recommend documenting the new contracts, accepting both stop-speaking frame types (or stating the stricter precondition), and only setting speech_segment_config when the user opted in.
